rules.name: Drilled
rules.description: If all the models in a unit of 5 or more models with this trait are in base to base contact with each other, the unit is considered to be In Formation. While In Formation, the unit gains the Big Target trait, the Intimidating trait, and a -1 bonus to its Melee Save tests. When the unit includes a Non-Commissioned Officer, it also gains a -1 bonus to its Resolve tests.

rules.name: Hidden Setup
rules.description: When the unit begins the game deployed, it cannot be attacked until it moves or shoots.

rules.name: Marksman
rules.description: This unit may target specific models within range and line of sight when shooting. If any hits are scored, the targeted model must perform the Shoot Save test, and is removed as a casualty if it fails.

rules.name: Intimidating
rules.description: Opponents hit by this unit must add an extra 1d10 to the Resolve test.

rules.name: Slow Reload
rules.description: This unit receives 2 Reload markers after shooting.

rules.name: Non-Commissioned Officer
rules.description:
Designate a single model to be a Non-Commissioned Officer (NCO).
The NCO’s unit counts as being in command range as long as this model is still part of it.
A formed unit with an NCO gains a -1 bonus to its Resolve.

rules.name: Musician
rules.description:
Add a single model to the Leader Unit to act as a Musician.
The Leader’s command range is doubled while this model is part of the unit.
Armed as modeled.

rules.name: Cavalry
rules.description: May take a free Advance action at any point during their activation. Mounted units suffer a +1 penalty to their Shoot Save and Shoot skills. This unit may mount or dismount as part of an Advance action. One model may be used as a horse holder after dismounting. Otherwise, the horses leave the battlefield and the unit loses this trait for the rest of the game. Horses can also be used as Hard Cover when taking the Take Cover action and the unit loses this trait as they cannot mount again when the horses are removed from the game.

rules.name: Blood Curdling Charge
rules.description: -1 to Melee test during Charge actions while mounted.
